import tempfile
import unittest

from payhook.config import load_config, read_dotenv
from payhook.doctor import format_doctor

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


def write_env(text):
    handle, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".env")
    with os.fdopen(handle, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    return path


class DotenvEdgeCaseTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_export_with_quotes_and_crlf(self):
        path = write_env('export PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="abc"\r\nexport\tPAYHOOK_REGION=\'us\'\r\n')
        values = read_dotenv(path)
        self.assertEqual(values["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"], "abc")
        self.assertEqual(values["PAYHOOK_REGION"], "us")

    def test_value_keeps_inner_quotes_and_equals(self):
        path = write_env('PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET="a=b\'c"\n')
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET"], "a=b'c")

    def test_mismatched_quotes_are_kept_verbatim(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_REGION=\"us'\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_REGION"], "\"us'")

    def test_comments_and_blank_lines_ignored(self):
        path = write_env("# note\n\nPAYHOOK_REGION=us\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path), {"PAYHOOK_REGION": "us"})

    def test_repo_dotenv_loads(self):
        config = load_config(environ={}, dotenv_path=os.path.join(ROOT, ".env"))
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT"][0], "https://api.payments.example/v2?region=eu&mode=live")
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT"], ("15", ".env"))
        self.assertTrue(config["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"][0].startswith("sk_live_"))
        self.assertFalse(config["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"][0].startswith('"'))


class DoctorTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_secrets_are_hidden_and_sources_shown(self):
        secret = "sk_live_SHOULDNOTAPPEAR_123"
        path = write_env(f'PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="{secret}"\n')
        config = load_config(environ={"PAYHOOK_REGION": "ap"}, dotenv_path=path)
        out = format_doctor(config, path)
        self.assertNotIn(secret, out)
        self.assertNotIn("SHOULDNOTAPPEAR", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN", out)
        self.assertIn("hidden", out)
        self.assertIn("[source: .env]", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_REGION = ap  [source: env]", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT = 10  [source: default]", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET = <not set>  [source: default]", out)

    def test_url_password_is_redacted(self):
        config = load_config(environ={"PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT": "https://user:[REDACTED:email]/v1?x=1"}, dotenv_path="/nonexistent")
        out = format_doctor(config, "/nonexistent")
        self.assertNotIn("hunter2", out)
        self.assertIn("https://***@api.example/v1?x=1", out)
